cover_letter:
Dear Dalton team,

I'm writing to apply for the marketing internship at Dalton. Your AI-native CRO platform and the promise of real, published work from day one is exactly the kind of environment where I want to learn and contribute. The chance to work alongside founders, see the impact of my writing on a fast-growing product, and be based at Wintercircus in Ghent makes this an ideal fit.

As a digital marketer with a technical background, I sit at the intersection of SEO, content, and web. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, including an e-commerce store, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. At KXP, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I also designed and built WordPress sites from structure to content. My toolkit includes Python scripts and AI agents to automate repetitive tasks, and I'm comfortable with Canva for design. While I haven't yet shot or edited video professionally, I'm eager to learn and have a good eye across formats.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Ghent, and available for the duration my program requires. I'm a clear writer, fast learner, and not afraid to ask questions. I'd welcome the chance to bring my mix of marketing and technical skills to your team, turning content into measurable growth.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
